instances.claim: This tells me that there is a defined, bounded set of things called Cents, with fixed membership, such that the same five-stage passage is true of each member.
instances.why: "Every Cent" quantifies over a collection, but the draft has introduced only a design (line 1, Brenner's Lincoln on the penny) and a single chosen readymade (lines 2–3, "the object" in line 7) — a kind and an instance, never a counted set of Cents. The capitalized term arrives as though already defined, and the only mention of CENTS as a body of work comes thirteen lines later at 21, so at line 8 "every" has nothing to range over.

instances.claim: This tells me that the object had been losing its physical existence, or was at risk of doing so, and that its context had already been described as a force acting on it.
instances.why: "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" both presuppose a prior pull away from physical existence, and "its context" is definite as though the context were already on the table; lines 4–6 establish only a collapse of monetary value, which is a different claim from dematerialization, and no earlier line names a context at all. The line parses and sounds conclusive precisely because the state it pushes against is missing rather than contradicted.
